<abstract>Objective The prevalence of diabetes mellitus and associated complications is steadily increasing. Principal component analyses of plasma targeted metabolomics and lipidomics data and of proteome profiles from pancreas, liver, and kidney cortex clearly separated MIDY and WT samples.
